card.line: Thebes was a great city of ancient Egypt on the Nile, home of the god Amon, and the Bible shows God judging it along with Egypt.

moments.title: Judgment on Amon of Thebes
moments.text: The LORD says He will punish Amon, the god of Thebes, along with Pharaoh and Egypt. He says those who trust in Pharaoh will be punished too.

moments.title: Thebes Will Be Split Open
moments.text: God says He will carry out judgment on Thebes and cut off its crowds. He says Thebes will be split open when He sets fire to Egypt.

moments.title: A Lesson for Nineveh
moments.text: Nahum asks Nineveh if it is better than Thebes. Thebes sat by the Nile with water as its wall and strong allies, yet it went into captivity.
